course.title: System Development Project
course.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

content.value: A company assigns software development projects to two teams, Team A and Team B, (06) [CO1] based on workload distribution:
• Team A completes 45 out of 75 assigned projects successfully.
• Team B completes 32 out of 40 assigned projects successfully.
Historically, 60% of all projects are assigned to Team A, and the rest are assigned to Team B.
If a project is chosen at random, what is the probability that it will be successful?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2023
